decisions.statement: A path is named from the repo root.
The files every shell compiles are read from the akasha checkout on disk.
Composing the paths a run is built from reads no checkout.
No page's own TypeScript file reaches the macbook.
A path relative to the shell package answers to wherever that shell sits.
The icon is the one input named on the app's page rather than held in akasha.

definition: the repo-root paths a mobile sim run is built from
